advance_policy.advance_issue_165_only_if: classification is HYPERSPHERICAL EFFECT or RETAINED-RADIUS EFFECT
advance_policy.geometry_specific_continuation: only classifications HYPERSPHERICAL EFFECT or RETAINED-RADIUS EFFECT
advance_policy.hyperspherical_effect: unit_hypersphere - shared_generic has simultaneous upper <= -0.01, every seed <= -0.01, unit_hypersphere - independent_flat simultaneous upper <= +0.01, and resource gates pass; retained-radius gate does not take precedence
advance_policy.invalid_instrumentation: any source, transmitter, causal, target-poisoning, initialization, finite-value, recurrence, accounting, preregistration, or deterministic-publication gate fails before interpretation
advance_policy.no_topology_benefit: no recurrent topology meets a frozen efficacy or parameter-efficiency rule, including when independent flat is materially superior
advance_policy.retained_radius_effect: retained_radius - unit_hypersphere has simultaneous upper <= -0.01, every seed <= -0.01, retained_radius - independent_flat simultaneous upper <= +0.01, and resource gates pass
advance_policy.shared_depth_effect_only: neither geometry family qualifies and shared_generic either materially/seed-consistently improves over independent_flat or is noninferior with simultaneous upper <= +0.01 while reducing trainable parameters by at least 40%
advance_policy.stop_policy: NO TOPOLOGY BENEFIT, SHARED-DEPTH EFFECT ONLY, or INVALID INSTRUMENTATION stops #165; do not invent another radius parameterization

allowed_stability_operations: deterministic first-axis direction at zero/near-zero radius
unit projection only in unit-hypersphere condition
explicit log/exp radius decomposition and sphere log/exp map only in retained-radius condition
the inherited AdamW gradient clipping at norm 1.0

data_and_budget.objective: causal next-byte cross-entropy; validation NLL per original UTF-8 byte
data_and_budget.source_membership: exact #123/#162/#163 calibration/evaluation source-document membership and byte segments

gradients: state gradient RMS by recurrent depth
radial gradient RMS by recurrent depth
tangential gradient RMS by recurrent depth
parameter pre-clip norm and update norm
resources: unique operator copies and effective reuse

excluded_hypotheses: continuous depth, Neural ODEs, or DEQs
adaptive computation or dynamic shell counts
shell-width growth or literal surface-area-scaled widths
Mixture of Shapes routing or #170-#173 model selection
parameter_matching_rationale: The shared generic, unit-hypersphere, and retained-radius models contain exactly one frozen #163 operator plus the same byte head. The independent flat condition requires three independently trainable copies to isolate ordinary depth. The exact #163 depth-1 anchor is the practical same-parameter flat control; width reduction or another adapter would violate the frozen block.

prior_art_boundary.specific_tested_hypothesis: whether an explicit retained rho in x=exp(rho)*u adds predictive capability beyond the strongest unit-hypersphere shared-depth control

resource_policy.dense_flop_rule: exact equality across all four effective-depth-three primary arms
resource_policy.geometric_operations: report phase normalization, unit projection, log/exp, and geodesic operations separately from dense FLOPs
resource_policy.parameter_rule: shared/unit/retained exact equality; independent flat reports its required three operator copies
resource_policy.processed_bytes: exact equality across all trained cells
resource_policy.shared_efficiency_joint_criterion: shared_generic - independent_flat simultaneous upper <= +0.01 and at least 40% trainable-parameter reduction

shell_coordinate_decision.reason: the frozen positional signal plus evolving recurrent state already breaks depth/token symmetry; adding a coordinate would introduce avoidable capacity and a fifth primary arm

stabilization_policy.near_zero_policy: radius <= epsilon uses rho=log(epsilon), deterministic first-axis direction, and zero reconstruction when inactive
stabilization_policy.post_freeze_changes_allowed: instrumentation defects only; no topology, threshold, source, capacity, budget, normalization, or projection changes
stabilization_policy.sphere_map: shortest-path log map and exponential map with epsilon-guarded tangent norm
stabilization_policy.unit_projection: epsilon-guarded L2 projection before step one and after every recurrent step only in unit_hypersphere

statistics.resampling: paired source-document block bootstrap with fixed seeds averaged within source and the exact #123/#162/#163 integer draw schedule
statistics.sign: negative means the first named arm has lower/better NLL

topology_config.phase_attention: radial dot plus normalized real-Hermitian angular Q/K score
